subject: Re: SDLC artifact set for AcmeBank SIG intake
content:
From: James Ortega <jortega@acmebank.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@acmebank.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SDLC artifact set for AcmeBank SIG intake

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Acme Bank's SIG intake for our platform evaluation, our assessments team needs a compact artifact set showing how Redwood enforces and evidences secure SDLC controls. Specifically we need:

- Latest code review policy and a few representative code review reports for the primary repos (redwood-inference-core, infra-deploy).
- CI/CD run logs (last 90 days) and the pipeline config that enforces branch protections / gated merges.
- Evidence of automated secret scanning and any recent findings/remediation (summary only).
- Change management trail for one recent production change (CR-12345 or similar) including approvals and rollbacks if any.
- Access control matrix for repo admins vs. approvers (high level).

Could you deliver these artifacts by EOD Monday, Nov 30? If you prefer, a secure Drive folder link is fine for the documents. If any items are restricted, please indicate what we can provide instead (e.g., sanitized logs).

Thanks,
James
--
James Ortega
Senior IT Risk Analyst, Acme Bank
audit@acmebank.com

Folks — attaching the secret scanning summary and brief note on secrets lifecycle. Short summary:

- secret_scanning_summary_20261130.csv: automated scanner (internal fork of an open tool) produced 12 low/medium alerts in the past 90 days; 12 were triaged and marked remediated (timestamps included). No secrets leaked to public registries.
- We run ephemeral credentials via our Vault with a 24-hour rotation TTL for compute credentials. The rotation schedule and an anonymized rotation audit are in the Drive folder.
- Access control: repo admin list is maintained in the Access Control Matrix (ACL) in the folder. Approver role = team leads + SRE oncall.
- If Acme needs deeper raw evidence (signed audit logs), we can provide them under a narrow NDA and secure SFTP transfer.

Drive link (artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Acme-SIG-artifacts
Jira SUP ticket for change export: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SUP-9876

Attachments: secret_scanning_summary_20261130.csv

Thanks — let me know if you need a short walkthrough meeting.

– Soojin
